Class Edge

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Edge
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented
Direct Known Subclasses:
EpistemicEdge, TemporalEdge
public abstract class Edge extends Numbered implements Commented
An edge represents a directed relationship from a tail node to a head node with a label in a story graph.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • prune

      protected void prune(Predicate<Object> predicate)
      Removes any pruned elements from this element, and if this element itself should be pruned its ID number will be set to Settings.PRUNED.

      An edge will be pruned if its tail node, label, or head node have their ID numbers set to Settings.PRUNED.

      Overrides:
      prune in class Numbered
      Parameters:
      predicate - a predicate which returns true for any story graph element that should be removed
